measures.label: All deaths
measures.description: Deaths from any cause, counted in the county where the person lived.
measures.source: US Census Bureau Population Estimates, Vintage 2025 (components of change)
measures.notes: Estimate years run July 1 to June 30. Connecticut is published by planning region and is not shown.

measures.label: All deaths
measures.description: Deaths from any cause, counted in the county where the death happened. Counties with hospitals, hospices and nursing homes take in deaths from neighbouring counties.
measures.source: CDC NCHS — provisional death counts by county of occurrence (total deaths columns of the COVID-19 tables)
measures.notes: 2020 from the annual county-of-occurrence table; 2020–23 is the Jan 2020–Jun 2023 total divided by 3.5 years. CDC stopped these tables in 2023. Counties with 1–9 deaths are blank. The rate divides deaths that happened in the county by its resident population. Newer county-of-occurrence data exists only as manual exports from CDC WONDER (no API).

measures.label: Drug overdose deaths
measures.description: Deaths from drug overdose of any intent (unintentional, suicide, homicide, undetermined).
measures.source: CDC NCHS, National Vital Statistics System — Mapping Injury, Overdose, and Violence (county)
measures.notes: County of residence. Where CDC suppresses counts of 1–9, the rate shown is CDC's Bayesian modeled estimate (marked 'modeled').

measures.label: Drug poisoning, long-run (modeled)
measures.description: Model-based estimates of drug poisoning death rates for every county, 2003–2021. Use for long-run trends; for recent years prefer 'Drug overdose deaths'.
measures.source: CDC NCHS — Drug Poisoning Mortality by County (small-area model)
measures.notes: Every value is a statistical model estimate, not a direct count.

measures.label: Heart disease deaths (adults 35+)
measures.description: Heart disease deaths among adults 35 and older, 2022–2024 three-year average.
measures.source: CDC Interactive Atlas of Heart Disease and Stroke (NVSS)
measures.notes: Rates are spatially smoothed by CDC, so small counties borrow strength from neighbours.

measures.label: Life expectancy
measures.description: Average years a newborn is expected to live at current death rates.
measures.source: County Health Rankings & Roadmaps 2025 (NCHS mortality files, multi-year pooled)
measures.notes: Each CHR measure pools several recent years (typically 3) to stabilise small counties. Connecticut uses 2022 planning regions in CHR and is not shown.
